name: servestack
description: Tools for independent restaurant owners: website, Google listing and Maps ranking checks, a delivery-app commission calculator and dish-photo makeovers for any restaurant, plus menu, sales and marketing tools for restaurants on ServeStack.

interface.longDescription:
ServeStack helps independent restaurant owners run and grow their restaurant business: how customers find them online, their menu, their sales and their marketing.

Any restaurant owner can use, without an account:
- Website check: see what a restaurant's website is missing for customers — an online ordering link, a readable menu, a tap-to-call phone number, hours and address, or details Google and AI assistants can read — with the top fixes.
- Google listing check: find what's missing or wrong on the restaurant's Google Business Profile — unclaimed, no website, no hours, no menu link, few photos.
- Google Maps ranking: see where the restaurant shows up for searches like "pizza near me" from points around it, and who ranks above it.
- Delivery-app commissions: work out what DoorDash, Uber Eats and other apps take each month, year and order, from the owner's own numbers.
- Dish photo makeover: turn a phone photo of one of your dishes into a polished, full-size food photo for a menu or Instagram (one per person).

Restaurants that use ServeStack can connect their account and ask about their restaurant in plain words: a sales briefing compared with an earlier period, the live menu, and whether ordering, payments and connected services are working. It can also edit menu items and mark dishes sold out, make marketing designs from real dishes, and post them to connected social accounts — always showing the change first and acting only after the owner confirms.
defaultPrompt: Why isn't my restaurant showing up on Google Maps?
How much am I paying delivery apps in commissions each month?
Make this photo of our dish look professional
